versions.content: The source address of the response transmitted via generic connections can be read from the configuration parameter DcmDspProtocolE- cuAddr . It shall be provided to PduR_DcmTransmit() in the MetaDataItem SOURCE_ADDRESS_16, if that is configured for the transmit PDU.
